current_concerns.primary_problems: I’ve been exhausted and tearful a lot, and kind of irritable too. It’s been going on for about eight months. I’m caring for my mother who has dementia, and I’m working two jobs, so I barely have any time to myself. I also get headaches pretty often.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like some help with my mother, and honestly I want to sleep more than five hours. Maybe some respite care too, if that’s possible.
